clue.text: Friend that is straddling blue fence

parts.note: pal is an informal word for a friend

indicators.note: to straddle is to sit astride, so the first pieces sit on either side of the next one

parts.note: i.e. is the abbreviation of id est, that is
feeling blue means feeling sad

explanation.surface: Someone's mate, feeling glum, sits astride a garden fence.
explanation.walkthrough: 'straddling' puts PAL and IE either side of SAD: PAL-I-SAD-E.
explanation.definitionFit: A palisade is a barrier of pointed stakes, a kind of fence.

explanation.definitionFit: Blighter is British slang for an annoying or contemptible fellow.

explanation.surface: Musical notes ring out and hum.
explanation.walkthrough: 'played' rearranges NOTES ARE.

clue.text: Put in power, Nero then goes mad

indicators.note: going mad suggests wild disorder, so the letters are scrambled

explanation.walkthrough: 'goes mad' rearranges NERO THEN.
explanation.definitionFit: To enthrone is to install a monarch on the throne, giving them authority.

clue.text: Lovers in transgressions, including a wife going the wrong 23 way

indicators.note: the longer word takes the reversed pair inside it

parts.note: sins are transgressions

indicators.note: travelling the wrong way means the pair is read backwards
this word means the letters it governs are turned round, so they are read backwards

explanation.surface: Romantic suitors caught up in adultery, a wife straying.
explanation.walkthrough: 'going the wrong way' turns A W into WA, and 'including' puts it inside SINS: S-WA-INS. The '23' is a stray cross-reference from the newspaper text.
explanation.definitionFit: Swains are young men courting, poetic word for suitors.

clue.text: Old god with name that befits old character

parts.note: Thor is the Norse god of thunder

explanation.surface: An ancient deity with a name suited to a crusty old type.
explanation.walkthrough: 'old character' suggests a prickly person, but it is a letter of the Old English alphabet.
explanation.definitionFit: Thorn was a runic letter used in Old English for the th sound.

clue.text: One fellow keeping position, hard politician in Pakistan

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one

indicators.note: one word holds the others inside it

parts.note: a man is a fellow
rank is position in a hierarchy
H is the pencil abbreviation for hard

explanation.surface: A man clinging to office as a tough Pakistani statesman.
explanation.walkthrough: 'keeping' sets position and hard inside fellow, after the I. Imran Khan was a famous cricketer before entering politics.
explanation.definitionFit: Imran Khan, former cricket captain, led the PTI party and later became prime minister of Pakistan.

clue.text: Blame chap wrecking US resort

explanation.definitionFit: Palm Beach is a wealthy resort town in Florida.

clue.text: See female finally rip bras apart — not wanting to be seen as this?

definitions.text: not wanting to be seen as this?

indicators.note: torn apart, these letters are rebuilt in a new order
finally points to the closing letter of the word

explanation.surface: A feminist tears up her bras, refusing to be seen as a mere appendage to man.
explanation.walkthrough: 'finally' takes E from female, and 'apart' rearranges it with RIP BRAS. Eve was made from Adam's rib; Spare Rib was also a British feminist magazine.
explanation.definitionFit: Spare rib is a jocular term for a woman, from Eve being made from Adam's rib.

clue.text: Writer must have label on in US building of high security

explanation.definitionFit: The Pentagon is the US Department of Defense headquarters in Virginia.

clue.text: Homework's managed — then one's laid around before meal

explanation.definitionFit: Preprandial describes something taken or done ahead of dinner, like a drink.

clue.text: Pure little woman with wicked grin
